opportunities.name: KAYAK hotel search with guests, filters and sort
opportunities.description: Search KAYAK Stays for a destination and date range, set rooms/adults/children, then apply filters (star class, review score, amenities, style) and sort the results (e.g. price low to high).
steps: Open KAYAK and click Stays (Search for hotels)
Type the destination and pick the matching suggestion
Pick the check-in date and check-out date in the calendar
Open the rooms/guests picker and set rooms, adults, children and child ages
Click Search
On the results page, apply filters (hotel class, review score, amenities, style)
Open the sort menu and choose Distance or Price (low to high)

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris; Mar 27–Apr 2; 2 rooms, 3 adults; sort Distance, then Price low to high
Santa Fe, NM; Jun 16–18; 2 rooms, 3 adults
Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; Jun 6–10; 2 rooms, 3 adults + 1 child aged 7; review 8+, 3+ stars, free internet, Family style, air-conditioned; sort Price low to high
Los Angeles, CA; May 21–23; 1 room, 2 guests; 4–5 star filter

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On qatarairways.com, enter origin, destination and departure date, set passengers (adults/children/infants) and cabin class, show flights, then pick a flight and select a fare.
steps: On the Book widget (Flights or Qatar Stopover), type the origin and pick the airport
Type the destination and pick the airport
Open the Depart date picker, choose the date and click Continue
Open Passengers/Class and adjust adults, children and infants; choose Economy or Premium
Click Confirm, then Show flights
Click the fare price for the chosen flight
Click Select fare for the chosen fare family (repeat for the return leg if there is one)

instances.values: Colombo CMB → New York JFK (Qatar Stopover), 24 Jun 2023, 2 adults + 1 child, Premium (Business), Business Comfort fares
Doha DOH → Durban DUR, 28 May 2023, 2 adults + 1 infant, Economy, Economy Comfort fare

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways (Booking.com) hotel search with filters
opportunities.description: Through Qatar Airways' Book > Hotels partner site, search a destination and dates, set guests/rooms, sort or filter the results (price, neighbourhood, stars, Wi-Fi), and open a property.
steps: On qatarairways.com, click Book, then Hotels
Type the destination and pick the suggestion
Pick the check-in and check-out dates (or a flexibility option) and click Search
Adjust adults/children/rooms on the results page and click Done
Apply sort (Price lowest first) or filters (neighbourhood, star rating, facilities)
Click See availability on the chosen property, then Reserve

instances.values: Las Vegas, NV; Apr 10–16, 2023; 2 adults, 1 room; sort Price (lowest first)
Washington DC; Jun 5–6, 2023; 4 adults, 2 rooms; Downtown DC, 5 stars, Free WiFi; St. Regis → Reserve
